item.text:
Implemented the notification toggle in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:1) and [app/actions.ts](/workspace/app/actions.ts:1). The Server Action saves the new preference in an HTTP-only cookie, then calls `refresh()` from `next/cache` to re-render the current page without redirecting.

The preference defaults to on and is stored per browser. `npx tsc --noEmit` passes.
